title: OGLO Session Report Suite Generator
description:
Generate a standardized folder structure for each NWB session containing:
  - `session-yymmdd-oglo/report-suite.ipynb` (interactive report)
  - `session-yymmdd-oglo/report-suite.html` (fully compiled HTML export)
  - `session-yymmdd-oglo/figures/svg/` (vector exports of all generated figures)
The report suite will display the spectrolaminar motif, unit statistics per probe, metadata tables, MUAE (Multi-Unit Activity Evoked) examples, and absolute LFP power with SEM traces.

title: SVM Preprocessing Options
description: Expose baseline-subtraction parameters to normalize trial spike count vectors before training the SVM classifier.

title: Granger Causality Interactive Plot
description: Create an interactive Plotly network connectivity figure in jnwb/viz.py representing Granger causality graphs.

title: GPU-Accelerated Population Trajectory (PCA)
description: Utilize PyTorch or JAX Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on GPU to accelerate population trajectory dimensionality reduction (PCA) across thousands of active neurons.

title: GPU-Accelerated MUAe Envelope Extraction
description: Utilize CuPy or PyTorch 1D convolutions to perform high-pass filtering, rectification, and low-pass smoothing of raw electrophysiology traces on GPU to extract Multi-Unit Activity envelopes (MUAe).

title: SVM Preprocessing (Baseline Subtraction)
description: Integrate trial-by-trial baseline subtraction (pre-stimulus interval baseline firing rates) into the standard population decoding feature pipeline to control for slow drift and state fluctuations.

title: Interactive Granger Causality Network Visualization
description: Develop an interactive directed graph visualization using Plotly in `jnwb/viz.py` that maps inter-area Granger causality causality flow as edge thickness, permitting dynamic node dragging and hover inspections.
